lessonTitle: 67. Angles formed by parallel lines and a transversal
lessonTitleEnglish: Angles formed by parallel lines and a transversal
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Theorem: if two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, alternate angles are equal (the converse of the test).
stages.headlineEnglish: Theorem: if two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, alternate angles are equal (the converse of the test).

stages.headline: Consequences: with parallel lines, corresponding angles are equal and co-interior angles add up to 180°.
stages.headlineEnglish: Consequences: with parallel lines, corresponding angles are equal and co-interior angles add up to 180°.

stages.headline: Consequence: a line perpendicular to one of two parallels is perpendicular to the other.
stages.headlineEnglish: Consequence: a line perpendicular to one of two parallels is perpendicular to the other.
